{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.02

|gr1= Program Flow

|descr= Skips the current loop iteration, continues with the next one and returns the given value.

|s1= [[continueWith]] return

|p1= return: [[Anything]] - value to be returned when iteration is skipped

|r1= [[Anything]]

|s2= scriptHandle [[continueWith]] code
|s2since= arma3 2.22
|p21= scriptHandle: [[Script Handle]]
|p22= code: [[Code]] - Code to execute once the [[Script_Handle#Promise_Handles|Promise]] has completed. The code will be executed in [[Scheduler#Unscheduled_Environment|Unscheduled Environment]].
|r2= [[Nothing]]

|s3= scriptHandle [[continueWith]] [code, args]
|s3since= arma3 2.22
|p41= scriptHandle: [[Script Handle]]
|p42= code: [[Code]] - Code to execute once the [[Script_Handle#Promise_Handles|Promise]] has completed. The code will be executed in [[Scheduler#Unscheduled_Environment|Unscheduled Environment]].
|p43= args: [[Anything]] - Arguments passed into code in _thisArgs variable
|r3= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
// results in [2, "TEST", 4]
private _result = [1, 2, 3] apply {
	if (_x == 2) then {
		continueWith "TEST";
	} else {
		_x + 1;
	};
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[continue]] [[break]] [[breakWith]]
}}
